exposure: Continuous gamma ray exposure in utero
Total accumulated doses (360 mGy, 3,600 mGy, 7,200 mGy)
cohort: Pregnant C57BL/6JJcl mice were exposed to gamma rays during gestation.
finding: In utero low dose rate gamma ray exposure did not cause significant effects, but medium and acute high dose rate exposures resulted in dose-related growth retardation, delayed ossification, and gonadal hypoplasia/atrophy in pups.
gest_age: Exposure from Gestation Day (GD) 0-18; fetuses examined on GD 18.
